d:
Team India march into the final! The defending champions made a massive statement at the Women's Asian Champions Trophy, overpowering Malaysia in the semi-final to book their spot in the title clash! Fired up by Deepika’s brace and goals from Mumtaz Khan, Navneet Kaur, Sunelita Toppo, and Ishika, the Women in Blue are one step away from defending their crown!
Watch Women's 2026 Final SAT, Nov 28, 7 PM onwards on Star Sports & JioHotstar!
